hypothesis: Among trees actually planted, public information about enemy planter routes and local protection predicts failure to earn the initial price during uninterrupted ownership beyond a fitted cost, carbon, horizon and nearest-enemy-distance reference.
sample: Fixed blinded registration of 32 distinct cached physical opening-carbon maps in maps.json, 24 training and 8 held. Include both seats and every new planting with a complete outcome in the committed replay. No recaptures as fresh plantings. Exclude v1 locator or formal test maps. Mark early abnormal/incomplete terminal or unclassifiable exits; no substitutions after registration. Hajimi sample is already exposed, excluded from fit and held.
target: 1 if actual tree income while continuously held by its planter's side, minus its actual planting cost, is negative (tolerance 1e-8). Capture, natural expiry and normal game end recorded separately. Abnormal endings censored when still held. The earnings unit is official tree cash (before display rounding), including worker extraction credited to this tree. No hypothetical labels on unplanted cells.
features: Infer from the planting side's legal observation before issuing the order, including the selected planter and its occupied candidate site. Five comparisons use only public configuration, public rosters and the same seat's actually visible carbon. Reference uses price, sum of the four visible neighbor carbon values, remaining usable turns capped by lifespan, nearest enemy planter distance, with intercept. Full model adds confidence/competition for the four visible neighbors, other enemy/own planter and collector distances/counts, trend over 3 and 5 turns of the current nearest enemy planter, presence history mask, nearby own/neutral target and own/other base range. No map ID/players' identities, future actions, winning or outcome, or opponent-private carbon.
estimation: Two logistic readouts, same train-map equal weighting. Within each map equal weight per actual new planting. Train-only weighted centering and scaling of each nonconstant variable, scale floor 0.05; L2 0.02/2 times squared standardized coefficients, intercept unpenalized. Double precision deterministic L-BFGS, max 200, no tuning/early stopping on held, no class reweight. Constant model uses same train-map mean. Freeze both coefficient sets in weights.json before opening held outcome labels.
primary: Brier loss for nonpayback, averaging first within, then equally over the 8 physical holdout maps, compared with fitted four-variable reference. Require all eight maps populated, lower mean Brier and lower Brier in at least 5 out of 8; equal-map AUC on maps with both labels may not decrease, minimum four rankable maps. Otherwise fail or insufficient. Report NLL, per-map event counts/observed net cash, loss reason, exploitable positives and profitable trees assigned high risk. Risk>=0.50 diagnostic only. Subsequent tree theft after payback kept separate from failure-to-pay.
hajimi_exposed: After fitting and held grading, report DS seat1 plant t246/cell214 and 56, t255/cell89, t259/cell134, t261/cell120, the fixed comparison probability, full probability, gross/cost/net, exit/payment time. No fitting/tuning on Hajimi. A change in forecast or predicted ranking is not an independently realized profit, a site substitution or an observed game win.
